definitions.short: properly, to become aged , i.e. (by implication) to grow gray
definitions.full: H7867. sib שִׂיב verb be hoary (Late Hebrew שֵׂיבָה old age ; Assyrian šêbu , aged man ; Arabic () become hoary , Ethiopic (in derivatives); Aramaic סִיב be old ; grow old, grey hair ); — Qal Perfect 1singular וָשַׂ֫בְתִּי זָקַנְתִּי 1Sam 12:2 ; Participle שָׂב Job 15:10 (+ יָשִׁישׁ aged ).

occurrences.englishText: Now, behold, the king walks before you. I am old and gray-headed. Behold, my sons are with you. I have walked before you from my youth to this day.
With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men,
